logicalBugs.description: On Gitea’s Explore’s repository list, opening a page number beyond the last available page shows no repositories. The pagination control nevertheless highlights the last valid page, making an empty out-of-range response look like the contents of that valid page.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The requested page is used for SearchRepository before NewPagination clamps its display page, so the data and active page disagree.
reproductionPaths: On Gitea’s Explore’s repository list, opening a page number beyond the last available page shows no repositories. The pagination control nevertheless highlights the last valid page, making an empty out-of-range response look like the contents of that valid page.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, dashboard repository search does not preserve literal URL-special characters. A query containing # can silently drop later visibility filters, while & or an invalid percent escape can change/truncate the actual query and return repositories that do not match the typed text.
logicalBugs.rootCause: searchURL interpolates searchQuery into the URL without percent encoding; # starts a fragment and & starts another parameter.
reproductionPaths: On Gitea’s personal dashboard’s repository search, select Private only and enter a nonmatching query containing #. A public repository reappears while Private only remains visibly selected, and reloading preserves this mismatch instead of applying the literal query and visibility filter together.

On Gitea’s personal dashboard’s repository search, enter a query containing an ampersand or a malformed percent escape. The input retains the full query but repositories that do not match it appear, because the text is not preserved as one literal search value.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, browser Back can restore earlier repository results/URL while leaving later search or filter controls in place. On Explore, changing Sort after Back can silently reapply an undone Public/private filter; in admin repository inventory, the search box can keep the later unmatched query above the earlier results.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The change handler builds navigation from FormData of the restored form without synchronizing controls from the current URL on pageshow/popstate. Browser history can restore results independently of control values.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, explore keeps stale filter state after browser Back. Results and URL correctly restore to unfiltered search, but changing the sort reapplies the previously selected Public filter and hides private repositories again.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, branch search and Explore repository-description search can lose a valid substring match when the search text ends in a literal percent sign. Searching the ordinary prefix or another matching substring finds the same saved branch/repository.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Repository name/description searches pass user substrings to builder.Like. Its terminal-percent wildcard handling does not preserve a trailing literal percent as a substring match.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea’s Explore’s repository search, search for text in a saved repository description that ends with a literal percent sign. The correct repository disappears even though searching for the same prefix without the percent sign finds it.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, clicking a topic badge on Explore switches the repository search into topic-only mode (topic=true in the URL). The mode then persists through new searches and Clear Filter, but nothing on the page shows that it's active and the search controls offer no way to turn it off, so name matches are silently hidden.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The repository search form preserves topic mode as a hidden field while Clear Filter deletes only archived, fork, mirror, template and private, retaining topic.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, clicking a topic badge on Explore switches the repository search into topic-only mode (topic=true in the URL). The mode then persists through new searches and Clear Filter, but nothing on the page shows that it's active and the search controls offer no way to turn it off, so name matches are silently hidden.

logicalBugs.description: On Gitea’s personal dashboard's repository list, choosing filters that match no repositories replaces the whole panel with 'There are no repositories yet.', removing the search box, category tabs and filter dropdown, so the filters can't be changed back from the page.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The filtered repository count is assigned to reposTotalCount and the template uses its falsiness for the entire empty-panel branch rather than retaining controls for a nonempty account.
reproductionPaths: On Gitea’s personal dashboard's repository list, choosing filters that match no repositories replaces the whole panel with 'There are no repositories yet.', removing the search box, category tabs and filter dropdown, so the filters can't be changed back from the page.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, moving the personal or organization dashboard repository list to page 2 writes repo-search-page=2 in the URL, but reloading or opening that URL shows page 1 and removes the page parameter. Other search text can remain, making the linked page appear preserved when it is not.
logicalBugs.rootCause: mounted calls changeReposFilter, which resets page to 1 unconditionally before searching and replacing history, discarding the parsed repo-search-page.
reproductionPaths: On Gitea’s signed-in user's dashboard (/), moving the repository list to page 2 records repo-search-page=2 in the URL, but reloading the page or opening that URL shows page 1 again and drops repo-search-page, while any search text is kept.

On a Gitea organization's dashboard (/org/<org>/dashboard), moving the repository list to page 2 records repo-search-page=2 in the URL, but reloading the page or opening that URL shows page 1 again and drops repo-search-page, while any search text is kept.
